999008199.text:
目が覚めたかい？
どうだい、気分は

localizations.en: Coming to? How are you feeling?

999008199.text:
なんだか……もやもやが消えて……
こんなすっきりしたのは久しぶりだ……

localizations.en: The fog in my head... it's gone... I haven't felt this clear in ages...

999008199.text:
もしかしてなんだけど……
この島、コウセンが来たりしてた？

localizations.en: Just taking a wild guess here... but has Kosen been visiting this island?

999008199.text:
……え？　ああ、慰めにとかなんやらで香を置いて
去っていくことはあったけども……

localizations.en: ...Huh? Oh yeah, he'd drop by sometimes, leave some incense as comfort or whatever, then take off...

999008199.text: それだ。玉涎香の実験をしていたに違いない

localizations.en: That explains it. He must have been experimenting with the Jade Incense.

999008199.text:
罪も無い人々を使って人体実験をしていたとは……
討たれたのも当然の末路かと

localizations.en: To think he was conducting human experiments on innocent people... His death was well-deserved.

999008199.text: う、討たれた……コウセンがかい！？

知らなかったのかい？
まあ、離れ小島だ、知らないのも仕方ないね

localizations.en: You hadn't heard? Well, this is a remote island. Can't blame you for not knowing.

999008199.text:
そ、そうかい……へへっ、そいつを聞いて
余計にすかっとしたぜ

localizations.en: I-is that so... Heh, hearing that makes me feel even better.

999008199.text:
コウセンの人体実験のせいで、この島の人々は
理性をなくして好戦的になっちまってる……

localizations.en: Because of Kosen's experiments, the people on this island have lost their reason and become hostile...

999008199.text:
しかし困ったね。今使ったので、
レスナの作った薬はなくなっちまったよ

localizations.en: But we've got a problem. That was the last of the medicine Resna made for us.

999008199.text:
レシピはあるのでしょう？
作れば良いではないですか

localizations.en: Don't we have the recipe? We can simply make more.

999008199.text:
簡単に言うけどさー、あれを作るには
調合の技術と仙人の実がいるんだから

localizations.en: Easy for you to say, but making that stuff requires an alchemist and Sage Fruit.

999008199.text: 仙人の実だったらこの島にたんと生えてっけどな

localizations.en: If it's Sage Fruit you need, this island's got plenty growing all over.

999008199.text:
ふむ……だったら仙人の実を調達し、
薬を作って彼らを中毒から救ってやりましょう

localizations.en: Perfect... Then let's gather some, make the medicine, and save everyone from this addiction.

999008199.text:
そうだね。アタシもそれで異存はないよ
リーベとシトリンもそれでいいかい？

localizations.en: Sounds good to me. What do you think, Liebe? Citrine?

999008199.text:
この島を訪れた目的は凶暴な魔物の「管理」ですが、
それもすべては人々を教え導くため

localizations.en: Our purpose for visiting this island may be to manage dangerous monsters, but that too is all in service of the people.

999008199.text: 魔物を倒すついでに仙人の実も拾えばいいんでしょ？

localizations.en: We can just pick up some Sage Fruit while we're hunting monsters, right?

999008199.text: おめぇら、魔物退治にきたのか？

localizations.en: You folks came here to hunt monsters?

999008199.text:
まあ、ありていに言えばそうなるな。
魔物の場所に心当たりは？

localizations.en: Well, to put it plainly, yes. Do you know where we might find them?

999008199.text:
手をつけられねえ翼の魔物がいるんだ。
島のあっち側でよ、仙人の実はそっち側だ

localizations.en: There's this winged beast we can't handle. It's on the other side of the island, and that's where the Sage Fruit grows too.

999008199.text:
ありゃあ、それぞれ逆方向だね。
そこまで都合良くはいかないか

localizations.en: Oh great, more walking. Can't have things served up to us on a platter, can we?

999008199.text: それぞれ組を分け、二方面作戦が効率的かと

localizations.en: We should split into groups and execute a two-pronged operation for maximum efficiency.

999008199.text:
よく分かんねぇけどよ、もう夜になって辺りも暗い。
今日は村に泊まって明日にしたらどうだ？

localizations.en: I'm not sure about any of that, but it's getting dark out there. Why don't you stay in the village tonight and head out tomorrow?

999008199.text:
そうだな。夜の森は危険が多い。
きょうだいの力は信じているが万が一ということもある

localizations.en: Good point. The forest at night is full of dangers. I trust in my siblings' strength, but there's always the unexpected.

999008199.text:
せっかく稀な旅人が来てくれたってんだ。
盛大にもてなしてやるぜ

localizations.en: It's rare we get travelers like you folks. Let us give you a proper welcome!

999008199.text: おっ、宴？　いいねぇ、楽しいのは大歓迎さ！

localizations.en: Ooh, a party? Now you're talking! I'm all for some fun!

999008199.text: やれやれ、羽目を外しすぎないようにするんだよ？

localizations.en: Oh boy... just try not to get too carried away, okay?
